extras: Warning: This plugin is for advanced users only and can delete notes or worse.
intentEvidence: Lets you use the Obsidian plugin API in your snippets or JavaScript files to modify the behavior of Obsidian, just as if you created a plugin, but without the hassle.
problem: Users who want to add custom functionality or test plugin ideas do not want to go through the complexity of building a full, formal plugin.
summary: Allows users to write custom JavaScript or TypeScript code snippets and files to modify Obsidian's behavior using the Plugin API.
